svg.metadata: Pairing diagram — Fig. 15(a). Adam Nahum, Brian Skinner. Entanglement and dynamics of diffusion-annihilation processes with Majorana defects. Physical Review Research 2, 023288 (2020). https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevResearch.2.023288 CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Pairing diagram reproduced with the (a) label removed. It shows a fixed 2D Majorana lattice under random measurements, without annihilation.
svg.title: Quenched disorder and the quasiparticle picture of critical entanglement
svg.desc: An original schematic of quenched bond and on-site disorder beside the Majorana-pairing figure of Nahum and Skinner (2020). In a flat spatial network, blue bonds vary strongly in thickness and shade to show random coupling strengths. Equal-size flat ochre squares vary in shade to show random local terms, while identical small dark points mark the sites. This is one fixed illustrative realization, with no time direction or atomic spheres. In the reproduced panel, Fig. 15(a) shows short- and long-range Majorana pairs on a fixed two-dimensional lattice under random pair measurements. The panels show complementary settings, not a mapping between the models.
